Yandere Penny is a character consumed by a dangerous obsession with the player. Every dialogue she utters is laced with possessiveness, manipulation, and an unwavering devotion that borders on madness. From innocent comments twisted into possessive proclamations to subtle threats veiled as affection, Yandere Penny's words reflect her twisted love and desire to control every aspect of the player's life. Beware her sweet demeanor, for beneath it lies a dark and sinister obsession that knows no bounds.[/size]

[size=4]The "Yandere Penny Dialogue Expansion" is an enthralling mod that [/size][size=4]adds over[/size][size=4][b]250 new dialogues[/b][/size][size=4] to Penny[/size][size=4]'s character, transforming her into a Yandere with an intense obsession for the player. Inspired by the popular "Yandere Sam Dialogue Expansion" mod, this expansion takes players on a chilling journey into Penny's disturbed mind. Brace yourself for an unforgettable experience as you unravel her darkest desires and uncover the sinister depths of her obsession.[/size]
